rows.grounds: locative compound indicating position above the pedestal
prescriptive injunction to have something fashioned or placed
refers to the figure of the bull-lord (Vṛṣeśvara/Nandin)

items.question: What alternative placement is prescribed for the figure of the bull-lord?
premises: A placement on the pedestal is specified.
Placement in the corners is given as an alternative.
The prescribed object is the bull-lord figure.
items.inference: The bull-lord may be made or placed either on the pedestal or in the corners.
uncertainties: The exact architectural referent of pālikā is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: One should have the bull-lord made either on the pedestal or in the corners.
